listings.description: Discover a refined blend of style, comfort, and thoughtful updates in the heart of Leesburg. From the moment you enter, the soaring two-story foyer sets an elegant tone, opening to a flowing floor plan designed for gathering, entertaining, and everyday living. Recent improvements add even more value, including beautifully renovated bathrooms, brand-new kitchen appliances in 2026, a new HVAC system in 2024, new roof and windows in 2019, an irrigation system around the home, and a new brick patio in the backyard. At the heart of the home, the kitchen pairs granite countertops and generous cabinetry with the convenience of brand-new appliances, creating an inviting space for everything from quiet mornings to entertaining. Upstairs, the primary suite offers a relaxing retreat with vaulted ceilings, a spacious walk-in closet, and a beautifully updated adjoining bath with a separate soaking tub and shower. The basement with walkout stairs expands the home's versatility with flexible space for recreation, entertaining, hobbies, a home office, or additional living needs. An attached two-car garage and private driveway provide convenient parking and storage. Outside, the new brick patio creates another space to enjoy the backyard, while the home's Leesburg location keeps plenty within reach. Explore the restaurants, boutiques, and historic character of Downtown Leesburg, spend time along the Washington and Old Dominion Trail, or enjoy nearby parks, shopping, dining, and Village at Leesburg. Access to Route 7, Route 15, and the Dulles Greenway provides convenient connections toward Ashburn, Sterling, Washington Dulles International Airport, and surrounding Northern Virginia business and employment centers. With its impressive entry, connected living spaces, renovated bathrooms, significant recent updates, flexible lower level, new backyard patio, and convenient Leesburg location, this home brings together character, functionality, and improvements that can be appreciated from the moment you arrive. Photos may be virtually staged

Beautifully updated and move in ready! Main level boasts open space with cozy family room with fireplace and built in shelving, separate dining room, and updated kitchen with stainless appliances and custom island. Kitchen walks out to freshly stained and oversized deck backing to large flat back yard, common space, and trees. This home has a much desired two car garage entering into laundry/mud room. Upper level had three spacious bedrooms with large closets and two updated baths. Lower level is fully finished with a large rec room, bonus room being used as a 4th bedroom, and large storage and utility area. Walk up stairs take you from the rec room to the beautiful back yard. Fresh paint and new lighting throughout. Enjoy close proximity to schools, shopping, community pool and more. ROUGH IN FOR A FULL BATH IN THE BASEMENT. Excellent location and a move in ready home! Hurry!

Welcome to 164 Alpine Drive, a Richmond American Waterford in Evergreen Meadows built with the sunroom extension. Brick front, covered porch and manicured landscaping under mature trees set the tone before you open the door. Inside, a sunlit two-story foyer opens to a private office, formal living room and a dining room with bay window and box molding. The heart of the house is the oversized family room with its stone gas fireplace, open to a white kitchen with granite counters, tile backsplash, island cooktop, double wall oven and pantry. Just beyond, the vaulted sunroom with its palladian window is where morning coffee happens, and the door leads straight to the paver patio and a fully fenced, level backyard. Upstairs, the primary suite has an open sitting area, tray ceiling, walk-in closet and a bath with soaking tub, separate shower and dual vanities. Three more bedrooms with crown molding, a hall bath with dual-sink vanity and an upper-level laundry room complete the floor. The big-ticket items are done: roof 2025, main-level furnace and AC 2023, and upper-level heat pump 2018. The full basement is unfinished with a bath rough-in, a blank slate to finish down the road however you picture it. Evergreen Meadows comes with a community pool and tennis and pickleball courts, and Battlefield Parkway puts you on the Dulles Greenway in minutes: Dulles Airport in about 20, Reston and Tysons beyond. Old Town Leesburg, Wegmans at the Village at Leesburg, the Premium Outlets, Ida Lee Park and the W&OD Trail are all a short drive, with the wineries and breweries of western Loudoun just beyond. Evergreen Mill ES, Simpson MS, Loudoun County HS.

Prime Leesburg Location! Welcome to this meticulously maintained brick-front Colonial in the highly sought-after Ashton Downs community, ideally located in the heart of Leesburg. This Hampton model offers approximately 2,652 square feet of beautifully designed living space with 4 bedrooms, 2.5 bathrooms, and an oversized two-car garage with pull-down ladder for overhead storage and a radon mitigation system, all situated on a flat, private 0.23-acre fenced corner lot. This is your opportunity to own a beautiful home within walking distance of historic downtown Leesburg, local shops, restaurants, the W&OD Trail, Foxridge Park, Ida Lee Park, Loudoun County High School, and Elementary school. A bright two-story foyer welcomes you into the home. The main level features elegant crown molding, hardwood flooring, plantation shutters, a private home office ideal for remote work, a formal living room with a cozy gas fireplace, and a spacious dining room perfect for entertaining. The gourmet kitchen is the heart of the home, featuring white cabinetry, granite countertops, a large center island, newer appliances, hardwood flooring, and a sunny breakfast area. The adjoining two-story vaulted ceiling family room flows seamlessly into the spectacular cathedral ceiling sunroom addition with four recessed skylights, filling the space with natural light. Double French doors open from the family room to the sunroom, and from there you can step onto the large Trex deck, creating the perfect setting for outdoor dining, grilling, and relaxing while overlooking the private fenced backyard. Upstairs, the spacious primary suite offers another vaulted ceiling, a large walk-in closet, and an en-suite bath featuring a double-sink vanity, Jacuzzi soaking tub, and separate shower. Three additional generously sized bedrooms share a hall bathroom, providing comfortable accommodations for family and guests. An exceptional bonus is the fully encapsulated lower-level crawl space, an incredible amount of clean, conditioned space. This versatile area is equipped with two HVAC units (Main House and Sunroom) and a sump pump, providing year-round comfort, peace of mind, and storage potential rarely found in homes of this size. New roof (2021) inspected annually, and biannually maintained HVAC systems (incl. new heat exchanger installation), offering peace of mind for years to come. Combining timeless finishes, thoughtful updates, exceptional storage, and an unbeatable location, this move-in-ready home truly has it all. Ashton Downs is one of Leesburg's most desirable neighborhoods, known for its welcoming community atmosphere, mature trees, and exceptional convenience. Enjoy easy access to the W&OD Trail, Foxridge Park, Ida Lee Park, top-rated Loudoun County schools, and the charming shops, restaurants, breweries, and year-round events of historic downtown Leesburg. Commuters will appreciate remarkably convenient access to the Dulles Greenway, Route 7, and Route 15, while the Silver Line Metro and Washington Dulles International Airport are both approximately 20 minutes away, making Northern Virginia and the Washington, D.C. metropolitan area, and excursionist travel effortless.

Bring your BEST OFFER! Looking for that affordable gem near historic downtown historic Leesburg, look no further. This home and community is just around the corner from historic downtown Leesburg, Rust Library and Ida Lee Recreation Park. It's a great opportunity and move in ready. Solidly built, all brick home, on a quarter acre corner lot with NO HOA. Short and easy walk to the heart of downtown Leesburg with local shops, dining, community events, plus easy access to numerous commuter routes. The welcoming front porch invites you into a spacious, freshly painted home with gorgeous hardwood floors flowing throughout the main level with 3 bedrooms and 2 full bathrooms. The living room has a huge picture window for natural light and built-in shelves surrounding the gas fireplace. The dining room, also with a huge picture window with custom blinds, has chair molding, built-in cabinets and a ceiling fan. The kitchen, with new LVP flooring, includes double sinks, side by side fridge with ice/water dispenser, built in microwave, compact dishwasher and a gas stove. On the same level, the home boasts 3 generously sized bedrooms, all with cedar lined closets and ceiling fans, with an en-suite bathroom for the primary bedroom. The lower level has a huge family room with a cozy wood burning fireplace and brand new carpeting, plus 2 bonus rooms with lots of potential to use as you see fit, with an abundance of storage room, a half bath, and also a utility sink. Outside you'll find a tastefully landscaped yard and plenty of parking for your family and friends, with the driveway descending behind the home with a lower level parking area and garage. Home has been updated with a new HVAC installed in 2022. The detached outdoor shed has an exterior electric charging station for your car or RV. Don't miss this opportunity to own this solid home in good condition and in a wonderful community and location!

The first impression at 825 Santmyer Drive SE is not simply that the home has been updated, it is how beautifully it has been cared for. Immaculate from top to bottom, every space feels polished, intentional, and genuinely loved, with thoughtful finishes that give the home a character all its own. An oversized statement light welcomes you in the foyer, setting the tone for a home that feels both distinctive and timeless. Hardwood floors carry through the main level, and there is no carpet anywhere in the home, creating a clean, cohesive flow from room to room. The living room is especially generous-noticeably larger than many in the neighborhood-with plenty of space to gather, entertain, or simply settle in comfortably. Upstairs, new flooring installed in 2026 continues the fresh, seamless feel. The primary bedroom is a true standout, with proportions rarely found in the neighborhood. Its exceptional size comes from a modification the original owner reportedly persuaded the builder to make to the standard floor plan, giving the room a spaciousness that may be entirely unique to this home. The primary bathroom was refreshed in the last five years with a luxury shower, flooring, mirrors, and lighting, while the hall bathroom was upgraded in 2024. The finished lower level brings even more flexibility without feeling like an afterthought. Remodeled in 2025 with new flooring and an updated bathroom, it is ready to become whatever suits your life best: a rec room, movie space, home gym, office, guest area, playroom, or a combination of several. Outside, the flat lot gives you plenty of usable space, with a mature tree line extending along the back of the property. The deck was replaced in 2024, offering a refreshed setting for grilling, dining, or relaxing outdoors. Replaced French doors connect the home to the deck, and improvements to the roof, driveway, and front walkway contribute to the same pristine, carefully maintained feeling found inside. Many of the less visible-but equally important-updates have already been handled as well. The HVAC was replaced in 2018, followed by the water heater and sump pump in 2022. These are the improvements that make a home feel reassuringly move-in ready, not just beautiful during a showing. Tavistock Farms offers the charm and neighborhood feel of an established Leesburg community, with neighborhood walking paths and a connecting path to the W&OD Trail. Shopping, dining, recreation, commuter routes, and everything else Leesburg has to offer are also within easy reach. What makes this home special is the way it all comes together: unusually spacious rooms, timeless details, a flat backyard, extensive updates, and a level of care that can be felt throughout. It is the rare established home where everything feels crisp, current, and ready to be enjoyed from the moment you arrive.

Nestled in the prestigious Stratford community, this exquisite Colonial-style residence offers a harmonious blend of luxury and comfort, perfect for those seeking an elevated lifestyle. With a generous 3,054 square feet of meticulously designed living space, this home has undergone significant renovations in 2023, ensuring modern elegance throughout. Step inside to discover an inviting open floor plan that seamlessly connects the family room, dining area, and kitchen, creating an ideal space for both entertaining and everyday living. The family room, adorned with built-ins and large windows, invites natural light, while the kitchen boasts ample table space, perfect for casual dining. High-end appliances, including a sleek refrigerator, dishwasher, and stove, make culinary endeavors a delight. The home features four spacious bedrooms, including a luxurious primary suite complete with an en-suite bath, offering a private retreat. Each bathroom is thoughtfully designed, showcasing modern fixtures and finishes that elevate daily routines. The fully finished basement adds versatility, providing additional living space for recreation or relaxation. Exterior highlights include a beautifully landscaped corner lot, enhancing curb appeal and providing a sense of privacy. Enjoy outdoor living on the expansive deck, perfect for summer gatherings or quiet evenings under the stars. The community amenities are equally impressive, featuring a sparkling outdoor pool, jogging paths, and playgrounds, fostering a vibrant neighborhood atmosphere. Additional conveniences include an attached two-car garage with a garage door opener and ample driveway space for guests. The property is strategically located near the airport and within a mile of public transportation, ensuring easy access to the surrounding area. With its combination of high-end features, thoughtful renovations, and a welcoming community, this home is not just a place to live but a lifestyle to embrace. Experience the perfect blend of luxury and comfort in this stunning Stratford residence, where every detail has been curated for your enjoyment.

listings.address: 143 Balch Springs Cir SE, Leesburg, VA, 20175
listings.description: Welcome to 143 Balch Springs Circle, a beautifully maintained brick-front home situated on an elevated lot, offering an impressive presence and added distinction from neighboring homes. Featuring a spacious floor plan, extensive recent improvements, and a convenient location near major commuter routes, shopping, dining, and everyday amenities, this home has so much to offer. Step inside to an impressive two-story foyer that opens to a bright and inviting main level featuring original hardwood flooring throughout much of the space. The expanded floor plan includes builder-added extensions to the gourmet kitchen, family room, and library, creating additional living space on both the main and upper levels. The kitchen is ready to impress with a complete suite of brand-new stainless steel appliances (2026), including a gas cooktop with downdraft, Wi-Fi-enabled double wall oven, refrigerator, dishwasher, and heavy-duty disposal. A new kitchen faucet, refreshed pantry, updated lighting, and fresh paint complete the space. A new washer and dryer (2025) are conveniently located on the main level. Upstairs, brand-new carpet (2026) provides a fresh feel throughout. The spacious primary suite features an updated bath with new faucets and toilet, refreshed cabinetry, and fresh paint. Additional updates throughout the home include new light fixtures and ceiling fans, new door hardware, freshly painted trim and baseboards, and numerous freshly painted interior spaces, all completed in 2026. The finished lower level offers approximately 1,400 square feet of additional living space with new LVP flooring, a full bathroom, walk-up access to the backyard, and a generously sized bedroom/office with an oversized walk-in closet-providing excellent flexibility for guests, working from home, recreation, or extended living. Major improvements provide added peace of mind, including a new Carrier HVAC system and heat pump (2024), 71-gallon natural gas water heater (2024), new roof (2018), and extensive duct cleaning and treatment. The oversized two-car garage has also been refreshed with newly painted walls, ceiling, doors, and floor, plus a second refrigerator for additional storage. Outdoor living is equally inviting with a spacious deck overlooking a well-maintained yard. The fence was installed and painted in 2024, while extensive landscaping, lawn treatments, tree trimming, seasonal plantings, and other exterior improvements have been completed through 2026. The driveway was freshly sealed in August 2026, and the deck railings, supports, and underside have been painted and maintained. With its beautiful brick-front exterior, elevated lot, thoughtful improvements across all three levels, expansive finished living space, oversized two-car garage, and easy access to Route 7, Route 15, the Dulles Greenway, restaurants, shopping, and surrounding amenities, 143 Balch Springs Circle offers an exceptional combination of space, convenience, and functionality.

Amazing view from the deck off the kitchen! The entire back of the house looks out over a sloping yard to a 134-acre Loudoun County-owned passive park (in conservation easement). Charming colonial with great floor plan! Hardwood floors on the main level, brand-new carpets upstairs, fresh paint throughout both levels. Roof replaced in 2018; windows replaced in 2017. Bathrooms have also been updated. Ready for you to move in and enjoy right away! Enjoy nature from your own backyard or take a stroll through the neighborhood (NO HOA!) filled with mature trees and friendly faces -- a great place to walk the dogs! Because it's within the Town of Leesburg, you get trash, road maintenance, snow removal, and yard waste (including fall leaf pickup). Fantastic location: 5-10 minute drive to the wonderful restaurants, shopping at Compass Creek, Village at Leesburg, the Outlet Mall, and much more are all less than a 10-minute drive! Check out First Fridays in the historic district and Leesburg's awesome Ida Lee Rec Center! A commuter's dream: super easy access to Route 7, the Dulles Greenway, Routes 7 and 15, and of course, Dulles Airport. OPEN HOUSE SUNDAY, SEPT 13th, 1:00-3:00

Welcome to this spacious 5 bedroom home with additional lower level-bonus room that can be used as a 6th bedroom with 2 walking closets and full bath. It is ideally located in Leesburg close to schools, shopping, restaurants, and major commuter routes, including the Dulles Greenway , Route 7, and Route 15. This well maintained home has been thoughtfully updated and is ready for its new owners. The entire interior has been freshly painted, and the beautiful hardwood floors throughout the main living areas has been refinished. The basement features brand-new carpeting, providing a fresh and comfortable additional living space. Outside, enjoy a newly built deck, completed just this month, along with freshly painted fencing. The garage has also been refreshed with newly painted walls and floor. Major improvement provide added peace of mind, including a new sewer line August 2026, a roof replaced 2018, a water heater and water pump replaced in 2022, and HAVC replaced in 2025. With generous living space, numerous recent updates, and easy access to everything Leesburg has to offer, this home is truly move-in ready. Do not miss the opportunity to make this home yours. "Please note: The property is currently vacant and listing photos have been virtually staged. Furniture and decor shown are digitally added."

Step inside to discover bright, sun-filled living spaces enhanced by abundant natural light and window blinds throughout the home, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. A cozy fireplace serves as the centerpiece of the main living area, while the well-appointed kitchen is a chef's dream, featuring high-end appliances, generous counter space, and ample storage for all your culinary needs. The home offers four spacious bedrooms, each providing a peaceful retreat. The luxurious primary suite serves as a private sanctuary, complete with an elegant en-suite bathroom featuring refined finishes and fixtures. With three full bathrooms and an additional half bath, the home is designed with both comfort and convenience in mind. The fully finished walkout basement adds exceptional versatility, offering the perfect space for a media room, fitness area, game room, home office, or guest retreat. Walkout stairs provide seamless access to the backyard, extending your living and entertaining space outdoors. Outside, the beautifully landscaped yard creates a serene setting for relaxing, gathering with friends and family, or enjoying quiet moments surrounded by nature. The attached front-entry two-car garage is equipped with a Tesla charger, providing added convenience for electric vehicle owners. Additional driveway and ample off-street parking ensure plenty of space for guests. Ideally located in a vibrant community with easy access to parks, trails, shopping, dining, and recreational amenities, this exceptional home offers a lifestyle of comfort, sophistication, and connection. Every detail has been thoughtfully curated to create a residence that feels both luxurious and welcoming. Don't miss the opportunity to make this remarkable Edwards Landing home your own.

Since purchasing this home in late 2024, the homeowners have made a significant investment in its comfort, efficiency, and appearance-thoughtfully improving the property with the intention of enjoying it for years to come. The result is a beautifully refreshed Lockmeade model offering nearly 3,300 finished square feet on three levels, 4 bedrooms, 3.5 baths, and a large, level, fenced backyard at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac. Among the most impressive improvements is the completely reimagined primary bath, a substantial renovation featuring a custom shower, upgraded vanities and fixtures, and enhanced electrical features. The home has also benefited from extensive interior and exterior painting, new flooring and carpet throughout the main and upper levels, replacement of all upper-level windows plus four additional windows, and significant HVAC and insulation improvements. The dramatic family room features vaulted ceilings, a wall of windows, recessed LED lighting, and a custom-built fireplace. Lighting throughout the home has been extensively upgraded with new fixtures, ceiling fans, recessed LEDs, dimmers, and motion-sensor exterior lighting. The hall bath and laundry room have also been renovated, with the laundry room receiving a new floor drain and washer and dryer. The finished lower level provides wonderful flexibility with recreation and media space, a full bath, abundant storage, and a dedicated gym enhanced with water and electrical improvements. Additional investments include radon mitigation, upgraded blinds throughout, exterior electrical outlets, deck lighting and power, a new deck landing, attic and garage insulation, exterior repairs and maintenance, landscaping enhancements, and more. Outside, enjoy a large, level fully fenced back yard, enhanced deck and three-season sunroom-ideal spaces for relaxing, entertaining, or play. These homeowners have truly cared for this property, addressing both the improvements you can see and many of the important items you cannot. Location is another standout. Potomac Crossing is ideally situated near historic downtown Leesburg and the natural beauty and walking trails of Ball's Bluff Battlefield Regional Park, while everyday conveniences are just minutes away. Enjoy easy access to Leesburg Premium Outlets, Target, Costco, restaurants, shopping and entertainment-offering a wonderful combination of neighborhood living, outdoor recreation and day-to-day convenience. Potomac Crossing offers a community pool, playgrounds, walking trails, and tennis. Video and audio recording onsite**

Welcome to 401 Crestwood Drive, where nearly $350,000 has been invested to thoughtfully restore this home from top to bottom. Situated on a desirable corner lot with a large backyard and oversized garage, this is far more than a renovation. Major improvements include a new architectural shingle roof, James Hardie siding and exterior wrap, new windows, central HVAC with all-new ductwork, water heater, plumbing, electrical, recessed lighting, and EV charging station. Inside, you'll find a completely redesigned kitchen with new cabinetry, under-cabinet lighting, countertops and appliances, along with a new primary bath, secondary full bath and powder room. Mohawk laminate flooring flows throughout the home, complemented by beautiful oak stairs, while the primary suite features newly designed walk-in closets. A new 6-foot privacy fence completes the backyard and creates an exceptional outdoor space for entertaining, pets and everyday living. Best of all, you're just a short walk from Historic Downtown Leesburg, with its restaurants, coffee shops, boutiques, Farmers Market and year-round community events. A completely restored, turnkey home offering modern living, an established neighborhood and the Downtown Leesburg lifestyle. Certain photographs have been virtually staged. Virtually staged photos are intended to help buyers visualize the property's potential and may depict furnishings, decor, or finishes that are not present in the home.

New Price! Welcome home to this move in ready home on a private lot backing to wooded common area in the conveniently located Silver Oaks community of Leesburg! Spacious living room with upgraded flooring leads to the spacious kitchen with upgraded appliances, built-in pantry, eating area & access to the deck. The main level also features two spacious bedrooms & upgraded full bath. Spacious lower level features large recreation room with access to rear yard, third bedroom, fourth bedroom/den, second full bath, laundry & storage! The expansive deck overlooks the wooded common area & steps leading to rear yard & access to under deck storage. This home is conveniently located near local schools, shopping, dining & commuter routes!

Welcome to 107 Appletree Dr NE, a spacious and beautifully maintained 4-bedroom, 3.5-bath Colonial nestled in the established, non-HOA community of Carrvale in historic Leesburg. Situated on a flat .24-acre lot, this home offers a fully fenced backyard, mature landscaping, and an impressive variety of fruit trees and garden plantings, creating a wonderful outdoor retreat. Inside, the updated kitchen features quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances-including a new stove-and abundant cabinetry. The kitchen flows seamlessly into a bright and inviting three-season sunroom overlooking the backyard, providing a comfortable space to enjoy the changing seasons. The upper level offers 4 generously sized bedrooms, along with a convenient second laundry room. Step outside to the spacious patio and private fenced backyard, ideal for entertaining, gardening, pets, or simply relaxing outdoors. The garden is a true highlight, featuring green and red apple trees, peach trees, red and white grapevines, and established tomato plants-providing plenty of opportunity for gardening and enjoying fresh produce right at home. The fully finished walk-up basement adds valuable flexibility with a den, kitchenette, laundry room with a new washer, and direct access to the backyard. This versatile space is ideal for guests, multigenerational living, a home office, gym, recreation area, or additional living space. Major updates include a newer HVAC system, a $9,000 water filtration system, and a 30-year architectural shingle roof installed in 2016. Located in the desirable Carrvale neighborhood, this home offers a quiet, tree-lined setting just minutes from everything Leesburg has to offer. Enjoy easy access to historic downtown Leesburg, with its award-winning restaurants, breweries, coffee shops, boutiques, and year-round community events. Nearby conveniences include Leesburg Premium Outlets, Village at Leesburg, grocery stores, fitness centers, and more.

Nestled in the prestigious Potomac Station, this exquisite Colonial residence embodies the pinnacle of luxury living. Spanning an impressive 3,407 square feet, this meticulously maintained home offers a harmonious blend of elegance and comfort, perfect for those who appreciate the finer things in life. As you approach the property, the classic architectural lines invite you into a world of sophistication. The front entry leads to a grand foyer, where gleaming hardwood floors set the tone for the rest of the home. The spacious layout features four generously sized bedrooms and three and a half bathrooms, ensuring ample space for relaxation and privacy. The heart of the home is the gourmet kitchen, equipped with high-end KitchenAid appliances, an island, coffee bar, and abundant cabinetry, making it a culinary enthusiast's dream. The adjoining dining area flows into the inviting living room, where a stunning gas fireplace serves as a focal point, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere for gatherings or quiet evenings at home. New roof (2025). Retreat to the fully finished basement, a versatile space that can be transformed into a home theater, gym, or entertainment area, tailored to your lifestyle with an additional room that could serve as a 5th bedroom. The convenience of an in-unit laundry area adds to the home's functionality, ensuring that daily tasks are effortlessly managed. Step outside to discover a community that offers a luxurious lifestyle, complete with access to a pristine community pool, perfect for sun-soaked afternoons and social gatherings. The landscaped outdoor space provides a serene backdrop for outdoor entertaining or simply unwinding after a long day. Parking is a breeze with an attached two-car garage equipped with an EV charger, and there is additional driveway space, ensuring that you and your guests are always accommodated. This residence is not just a home; it's a lifestyle choice that offers comfort in a sought-after community. With its prime location, you are just moments away from upscale shopping, fine dining, and recreational opportunities, making it the ideal sanctuary for those who seek both tranquility and convenience. Don't miss the opportunity to make this exquisite property your own.

Built in 1795 and just a few blocks from the heart of downtown Leesburg, 222 West Market gives you something that is genuinely hard to find: a historic home with real character, a completely rebuilt interior, private outdoor space, and a two-story garage, all in a location where you can walk out the door and enjoy downtown. The interior was gutted and rebuilt in 1998 by Randy and Deloris DeHart, with the work later recognized with a 2000 Architectural Excellence Award. Their daughter, a landscape architect, designed the grounds, and that attention to how the house and outdoor spaces work together is still obvious today. The BRICK COURTYARD is one of the places that makes this house memorable. It is tucked behind the home, with planting beds, an arbor, and a water feature filled with fish, lily pads, and water plants. There is even a resident frog who has apparently decided he lives here too. Sit outside with coffee, dinner, or a glass of wine and the sound of the water makes it easy to forget you are right in the middle of town. Inside, you get the character of a historic home without giving up comfortable room sizes. The FAMILY ROOM is nearly 23 feet long with a fireplace and radiant heat underfoot. The large front STUDY has another fireplace and enough room to work from home, read, or create a separate sitting space. The KITCHEN sits between the two with rich wood cabinetry, double wall ovens, a pantry, and direct access to the courtyard, so indoor and outdoor living connect naturally. Upstairs, the floor plan gives you TWO GENEROUS BEDROOMS instead of a collection of smaller rooms. The PRIMARY SUITE is more than 20 feet deep with its own fireplace, multiple closets, and a private bath with a skylight that brings in natural light. The second bedroom is also spacious, with another full bath nearby. LAUNDRY ON THE BEDROOM LEVEL makes everyday life easier. A long driveway runs to the back of the property, where the oversized TWO-STORY STUCCO GARAGE sits tucked away from the street. You get real off-street garage parking in downtown Leesburg, plus unfinished space above for storage or future possibilities. And then there is the LOCATION. King Street, downtown restaurants, shops, coffee, events, and the W&OD Trail are all close by. Dinner does not have to involve getting in the car. Neither does a morning walk, a bike ride, or an afternoon downtown. 222 West Market is considered one of the buildings that helps give the Leesburg Old & Historic District its historic character and charm. With its history, architecture, private courtyard, garage, and walkable downtown location, it offers a way of living that is very hard to recreate anywhere else. This one is very special.

Escape to your own peaceful slice of Loudoun County on 3.25 private acres, complete with beautiful views from the front porch. This charming 1923 farmhouse is receiving a fresh new look, including new paint throughout the interior, while preserving the character and unique details you would expect from a home of its era. Inside, you'll find a surprising amount of storage and plenty of opportunity to make each space your own. The septic system was completely replaced within the last six months, offering an important update and added peace of mind. Located approximately five minutes from quaint downtown Hamilton and just ten minutes from the Leesburg Premium Outlets, with downtown Leesburg, shopping, dining, wineries, and major commuter routes all within easy reach. A rare opportunity to enjoy privacy, space, character, and convenience in one special property. MORE PHOTOS COMING SOON

**Open House 9/20 from 12-2p.m.**Absolutely Impeccable...Gorgeous Single Family Home Located in Sought After Potomac Crossing-Why Buy a Townhome When You Can Have a Single Family Home on a Cul-De-Sac for the Same Price-This Incredible Home has an Open Floorplan with Cathedral Ceilings in the Breakfast Room and Family Room-Spacious Formal Spaces Welcome You on The Main Level with Brand New Large Format Tile and Custom Bamboo Hardwoods Throughout the Main Level-The Expansive Kitchen Includes Granite Counters, Fresh White Cabinets and New Lighting-The Cozy Family Room Includes a Wood Burning Fireplace and is Adjacent to A Light Filled Breakfast Room-The Second Level Features 3 Large Bedrooms and Two Full Baths-All Bedrooms Include Hardwood Floors and Have Been Freshly Painted-The Owner's Suite Features Cathedral Ceilings and a Large Walk-In Closet and Spa Like Owner's Bath with Soaking Tub-The Lower Level is Fully Finished with a Recreation Room, Full Bath and Large Den with Closet that is a Potential Bedroom #4-The Entire Home has Been Freshly Painted with New Carpets, New Light Fixtures and More-The Roof was Recently Replaced along with the HVAC and Hot Water Heater. Located on a Quiet Cul-De-Sac with an Expansive Fenced Backyard-This One Owner Home has Been Lovingly Cared for and is Turn Key Ready for it's Next Owner- Enjoy Incredible Community Amenities and an Impeccable Location Minutes from Downtown Leesburg and The Dulles Greenway-It is All Perfect!

Tucked away on a peaceful cul-de-sac in The Lakes and Red Rocks and backing to a serene wooded setting, this beautifully updated colonial offers the perfect balance of timeless elegance, modern comfort, and exceptional privacy. Thoughtfully improved over the years and meticulously maintained, this four-bedroom, 2.5-bath residence is designed for both refined everyday living and effortless entertaining. A welcoming foyer introduces the home's warm, sophisticated interior, where rich Brazilian Tigerwood hardwood flooring extends throughout the foyer, formal living room, dining room, staircase, and upper hallway, creating a seamless sense of style and craftsmanship.
